rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.subtype: Approach: safety first and quick triage [Thinking]
rows.description: When floodwater enters the street, a teen decides that people come before belongings, checks who is home, and moves grandparents and the younger sibling to the upper floor before anything else.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, forward planning, mental simulation

rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.subtype: Approach: following a practised emergency plan [Action]
rows.description: Using the family plan from school drills, a teen takes the emergency bag with documents and torch, switches off the mains as adults instruct, and goes to the agreed meeting point.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, forward planning, mental simulation

rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.subtype: Approach: calling for help and giving clear information [Action]
rows.description: After a road accident near school, a student calls the emergency number, states the exact place, how many are hurt and what happened, and stays on the line as asked while keeping himself out of danger.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, forward planning, mental simulation

rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.subtype: Approach: basic first aid within trained limits [Action]
rows.description: A teen who completed a school first aid course applies pressure to a bleeding cut and keeps the injured person calm and still until adults or medical help arrive, and avoids moving someone with a possible neck injury.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: contingency planning, forward planning, mental simulation

rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.subtype: Approach: freezing or denying the danger [Pitfall]
rows.description: At the first tremor, a teen keeps scrolling her phone thinking it is nothing and loses precious seconds, since she had never rehearsed what to do and no action came to mind.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, forward planning

rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.description: A teen wades into fast floodwater to rescue a pet, ignoring how strong the current is, and creates a second emergency, when calling adults and rescue workers would have been safer.

rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.description: After a cyclone warning, a student forwards a viral message with wrong evacuation routes, which confuses neighbours, and later learns to check official sources before sharing.

rows.subtopic: Responding to a natural disaster or accident
rows.description: A family agrees that if phone networks fail, they will meet at the community hall and contact one relative in another city, and the teen writes key numbers on paper.
